name: Branch of Cenarius
summary: In eastern Ashenvale, Geltharis holds the Branch of Cenarius, sacred to the dryads. Anilia died defending the relic, and her dying wish was to see it recovered.

sections.title: A Sacred Bough Fallen to Shadow
sections.body: The Branch of Cenarius is sacred to the dryads who follow the Forest Lord. Anilia and her sister Illiyana treasured it until corrupt satyrs ambushed them. Their leader, Geltharis, seized the branch and mortally wounded Anilia near the tainted ruins of eastern Ashenvale. As she lay dying, Anilia pointed north toward the arch where Geltharis lurks. She pleaded for a champion to take back the bough and return it to the dryads at Forest Song.

faq.q: What is the Branch of Cenarius?
faq.answer: The Branch of Cenarius is a sacred relic treasured by Ashenvale’s dryads. It bears the Forest Lord’s name and blessing, and represents their bond with the ancient forest.

faq.q: Who stole the Branch of Cenarius?
faq.answer: Geltharis stole the Branch of Cenarius after leading an ambush on the dryads near eastern Ashenvale. He mortally wounded Anilia and fled north beyond a stone arch with the branch.

faq.q: Who does the branch belong to?
aliases: who do i give it to
faq.answer: The branch belongs to the dryads of Forest Song. Anilia died defending it, and her sister Illiyana receives the relic in keeping with Anilia’s dying wish.
Geltharis carries the branch just north of the ruins in eastern Ashenvale where Anilia falls, near the border with Azshara.

angles.text: As a druid, you share a duty to reclaim the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr who defiled it.
As a night elf of Ashenvale, you have a sacred duty to aid the dryads and recover their ancestral treasures.
